quote.text: It is not that we have a short time to live but that we waste a lot of it.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Let each moment with your child be a lesson in mindfulness—cherish the time you have by engaging in meaningful conversations and experiences, rather than letting distractions steal away precious opportunities for growth and connection.
    • Embrace the idea that parenting is less about the quantity of time spent and more about the quality of attention given; invest in deliberate moments that nurture values, curiosity, and resilience in your children.
  • Leadership
    • Recognize that effective leadership is built upon the thoughtful use of time; avoid the trap of procrastination and always strive to set clear, purposeful goals that inspire and mobilize your team.
    • Foster an environment where your team learns to value every minute by modeling discipline, ensuring that collective efforts are aligned with intentional actions rather than aimless activities.
  • Product Management
    • Understand that in product management, time is as valuable as any resource—focus on prioritizing impactful tasks and streamlining processes to prevent wasted effort and accelerate progress.
    • Adopt a mindful strategy, continuously refining your approach; by being aware of time spent in meetings or planning, you can adjust to maximize creativity, speed, and value delivery in every project.
